files.purpose: Two-stage joint local refinement (circular orbits only) for the seed_20260919 scenario: independently fits shortlists of 16 inner and 16 outer candidates from local grids centered on the blind coarse solution (inner Mercury-scale circular; outer 2-4e-4 M_sun, 8.5-11 AU, phases 4.30-5.05 rad), then scores the 16x16 Cartesian product jointly on train and picks the best pair. Accepted if the refined pair beats the coarse reference pair (inner 3.0e-6/0.75/2.356 rad, outer 3.0e-4/10.0/4.712 rad) by >=15% on holdout AND both bodies hit tolerances (inner: mass<=50%, radius<=20%, phase<=0.35 rad; outer: mass<=30%, radius<=15%, phase<=0.20 rad). Differs from catalog_inner_refinement by fitting BOTH bodies jointly (no locked outer) and from the _inner_sensitive variant by circular-only candidates with no eccentricity parameter.

files.purpose: Two-hidden-body blind recovery benchmark on the same scenario: scores 11 (mass, radius) candidate families x 24 phases as single sources, keeps the winner plus a top-18 shortlist, then jointly scores every shortlist x full-grid pair on train (vetoing pairs with |delta radius| < 0.10 AU); accepts the two-source model if its holdout MSE beats the one-source holdout by >=20%, then greedily matches each candidate to the nearest withheld truth by radius and declares recovery only if ALL truth objects match within mass<=75%, radius<=40%, phase<=0.60 rad. Its measured outer solution (3e-4 M_sun, 10 AU, 4.712 rad) is what catalog_inner_refinement freezes as LOCKED_OUTER.

Blind one-hidden-body test with realistic N-body dynamics: truth is Sun + one hidden Jupiter (known orbit radius 5.2044 AU) + visible Saturn and Uranus; infers Jupiter's mass (11-point grid) and starting phase (48 steps) from 8 years of noisy Saturn/Uranus position tracks, scoring on a 2-year holdout. files.purpose: Blind structural-identification test: truth contains TWO hidden planetary sources (Jupiter-mass at 5.2044 AU + 2.80e-4 at 7.60 AU) plus visible Saturn/Uranus; pipeline fits one source, searches residuals for a second (excluding candidates within 0.15 AU of the first), jointly refines the pair, and selects one- vs two-source models by whether holdout MSE improves >= 20%. A trial passes only if the two-source model is selected AND mass/radius errors meet per-source tolerances (source A: 25%/10%; source B: 35%/12%).

gravity_mapper/catalog/solar_system_obje.purpose: Curated offline solar-system catalog (v0.1.0) used as the known-object prior for blind-scenario benchmarks; explicitly approximate, not a precision ephemeris.
gravity_mapper/catalog/solar_system_obje.structure: top-level keys: catalog_name, catalog_version, units, reference_epoch, source_note, objects. objects: 10 entries (Sun, Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Ceres, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune), each with object_id, name, class, mass_solar, orbital_radius_au, phase_rad, eccentricity, withhold_eligible. Units: solar masses / AU / radians.

scenarios/.purpose: Blind-scenario manifests: sealed truth + solver-safe inference JSON per scenario.

scenario_observations/.purpose: Noisy visible-body position time series (~1 MB each) generated from the full truth systems.

runs/.purpose: Timestamped benchmark run-result JSONs from the 2026-09-19 benchmark session.
